name: trace
description: A compact activity log for AI agents: `Trace` stacks `TraceLine`s (an optional `TraceIcon`, a `TraceTitle` and a `TraceDescription`), with a `status` of running (shimmering title), pending or error. Wrap a line in `TraceCollapsible` with `TraceCollapsibleTrigger` and `TraceCollapsibleContent` to reveal the details of a step.
